sanskrit_verse:
राज्ञा ये विदिताः सम्यक् कुलश्रेणिगणादयः ।
साहसन्यायवर्ज्यानि कुर्युः कार्याणि ते नृणाम ॥
transliteration: rājñā ye viditāḥ samyak kulaśreṇigaṇādayaḥ | sāhasanyāyavarjyāni kuryuḥ kāryāṇi te nṛṇām ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Those individuals recognized by the King—such as clan leaders, guild heads, and community authorities—who act without coercion or fear-based enforcement, shall execute the duties of the people.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derived from recognition by sovereign consciousness
Causation through voluntary alignment, not compulsion
Capacity-based responsibility rooted in social role and consent
Restoration logic centered on duty fulfillment, not punitive response
Consciousness alignment via dharmic execution of societal roles
executable_legal_axioms: IF an agent is recognized by the sovereign THEN that agent's actions must align with dharma AND exclude coercive enforcement.
IF a duty is assigned to a recognized authority THEN its execution MUST be free of fear, force, or punitive measures.
IF societal function depends on a group or individual THEN their capacity MUST be continuously restored through consciousness-aligned practices.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, only those authorities acknowledged by the sovereign consciousness of the nation may act on behalf of the people. Their jurisdiction is valid only when exercised without recourse to punitive or coercive mechanisms. The threshold of responsibility lies in recognition, not appointment; legitimacy arises from alignment with Dharma, not institutional power.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that true causality originates in conscious choice, not external enforcement. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals that fear-based action disrupts sequential harmony. Thus, proportional responsibility is measured by alignment with svadharma, not by punitive consequence. Non-punitive reality rule affirms that justice flows from completion, not correction.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Recognition reaffirmation process for all societal authorities
Consciousness alignment audit for duty-executing bodies
Voluntary compliance verification through svadharma resonance testing
Reintegration protocol for misaligned agents through guided self-realization
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this Dharma is declared: Justice flows from recognition, not punishment. Authority serves completion, not control. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the supreme adjudicator. Dharma is restored.
